# SR.Lobo Automation Bridge

Prebuilt Home Assistant add-on that connects a club's Home Assistant installation with SR.Lobo.

Add this repository in Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons > Add-on Store > ⋮ > Repositories, and paste:

```
https://github.com/LuPOS-hub/automation-bridge-addon
```

This repository only contains the add-on definition. The add-on is installed from a prebuilt image; no source code is published here.
